notes: Sub-assembly now reads as the reference's mechanism rather than a solid blade. Fixed this pass: the shell was one full-thickness extrude that completely enclosed the machinery box, ladder rack, coolant strip, terminal block and both pivot bosses. It is now a thin back plate plus separate leading- and trailing-edge spars, leaving the middle of the face open exactly as the reference draws it, with the machinery set proud so it is visible from the review camera. Fin profile is on measured numbers (0.54 waist at Y 0.88, 0.17 tip at 2.53). Colour differentiation of the internals (grey/yellow/teal/red) is material-pass work and not claimed here.

Seven capsule pods in two staggered rows read as slung, bulging payload with the cradle shelf above them, matching the reference's arrangement. Two defects fixed this pass: pods inherited the cradle box's non-uniform 3.65x1.24x1.30 node scale and rendered as enormous stretched capsules, so all children of dimension-scaled boxes were re-parented to root with the structural parent preserved in attachment; and the cradle at full envelope height enclosed and hid the entire cluster, so it is now a 0.70-tall shelf with the pods protruding 0.50 below it. Banding straps are micro-level and arrive at surface-pass.

Bay is now an open recess: the housing was a full-depth solid box that occluded the entire vane array and nozzle stack, and is now a back wall with the two mirrored 5-slat banks and the four nested triangular nozzle prisms set into the opening in front of it. Chevron reads from the review camera. The concentric red/blue/orange banding is colour, so it is material-pass work and not claimed here.
